# claude-code

<!-- Generated by tools/gen-docs.sh from modules/components/claude-code; do not edit. -->

Claude Code, the coding agent CLI (`claude`), on Linux and darwin, with its agent rules file, skill link root, settings targets and, optionally, Claude Code plugins.

The component lives in [`modules/components/claude-code`](../../modules/components/claude-code/):

- [README.md](../../modules/components/claude-code/README.md): what it installs, its options and its settings.
- [maintenance.md](../../modules/components/claude-code/maintenance.md): its pins and how `dotsteward-update` refreshes them.
- [default.nix](../../modules/components/claude-code/default.nix): the Home Manager module that fills the component contract.
- [seed.json](../../modules/components/claude-code/seed.json): the flake inputs and lock entries an instance starts with when it enables the component.

See the [catalog](../catalog.md) for the other components.
